content: Joint World Heritage Site in Germany. | Bauhaus and its Sites in Weimar, Dessau and Bernau is located in Germany Weimar  Weimar  Dessau  Dessau  Bernau  Bernau |. | Map Interactive map of Bauhaus and its Sites in Weimar, Dessau and Bernau |. **Bauhaus and its Sites in Weimar, Dessau and Bernau** are World Heritage Sites in Germany, comprising six separate sites which are associated with the Bauhaus art school. It was designated in 1996 with four initial sites, and in 2017 two further sites were added. For this reason, they are important monuments not only for art and culture, but also for the historic ideas of the 20th century." – *Application for the extension of the UNESCO World Heritage Bauhaus and its Sites in Weimar and Dessau*, German delegation to UNESCO, December 2015. The Bauhaus was founded in Weimar in 1919 by Walter Gropius and remained there until 1925 when it moved to Dessau due to political pressure.

title: Bauhaus and its Sites in Weimar, Dessau and Bernau
content: The Bauhaus buildings in Weimar, Dessau and Bernau are fundamental representatives of Classical Modernism, directed towards a radical renewal of architecture
